subject.title: claude-sonnet-5 missing from bundled Anthropic model catalog / GA-1M-context prefix list

question: Which open Sonnet 5 implementation path should be treated as the canonical fix for this issue before closing it?
rationale: Current main is still broken, but multiple open PRs overlap on the catalog/context fix and differ in how much alias, generated catalog, shared contract, and request-shaping surface they include.

options.title: Land the broader proof-positive catalog fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99463 as the canonical path because it covers the reported catalog/context gap plus adjacent CLI catalog and shared contract surfaces with proof.

options.title: Land the narrow closing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99313 if maintainers want the smallest catalog/context-only mitigation and are comfortable tracking the remaining Sonnet 5 surfaces separately.

options.title: Wait for full Sonnet 5 rollout
options.body: Hold the issue until the broader Sonnet 5 rollout or request-shaping work is merged if maintainers do not want catalog visibility to land first.

recommendation.title: Land the broader proof-positive catalog fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99463 as the canonical path because it covers the reported catalog/context gap plus adjacent CLI catalog and shared contract surfaces with proof.
